Shut Down of the Switch  
63. As I have explained, I did not personally attend the site to shut down any system, electrical supply or valve for the purpose of the FS Water Tank repair works. It was my understanding, based on what Mr Cheung told me, that the building management would arrange for the appropriate personnel to carry out such tasks.

64. After reading the witness statements of Mr Law Kwok Shui, a staff member of the building management (Bundle C1-2 Police (1222-1224)), I understand that he was the person entrusted with this task. In his statement, he stated that he shut down the primary switch for the entire fire service system.

65. Based on my knowledge, for the purpose of FS Water Tank repair works or shutting down the FH/HR system, it is not necessary to shut down the primary switch of the entire fire service system (消防系統總掣), nor is it necessary to shut down the entire fire service system.

Condition of the FS Water Tanks  
66. I note that Mr Chung Kit Man, a director and engineer of Victory Fire Engineering Limited, stated in his witness statement (Bundle C1-2 Police (1148-1151)) that upon inspection of the FS Water Tanks between 24 and 26 March 2025, all the FS Water Tanks at Wang Fuk Court were functioning and showed no leakage.

67. Mr Wong Kin Wa, an electrician (電工) of Victory Fire Engineering Limited, made a similar observation during the same period in his witness statement (Bundle C1-2 Police (1152-1153)).

68. These observations are inconsistent with what Gordon had told me and also differ significantly from the observations made by the workers who actually carried out the FS Water Tank repair works.
